title: Cooling technology mix
question: Which cooling technology mix supplies 20 degC?

options.label: Free cooling + electric chillers (C2, C5)
options.notes: candidates: C2-2d, C5-3d, C6-2d, C7-2d, C8-3d, C2-opt, C6-opt, C8-opt; top-ranked (LCOH ranking)

options.label: Free cooling + absorption + electric peak (C3, C4)
options.notes: candidates: C3-2d; excluded by DesignGuard/verifier: C4-2d

criterion.text: lowest lcoh_per_mwh + lcoc_per_mwh among guard-passed candidates without unmet demand in economics

rationale: Selected based on lowest lcoh_per_mwh among guard-passed options in economics as indicated by TR-016. Option electric-chillers was rejected for higher lcoh_per_mwh. Option free-cooling-absorption was rejected for higher lcoc_per_mwh compared to the selected configuration.
